data.subject: Local Ledger: SJT and GBLI
data.body:
Hi,

Cannell Capital's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in SJT and GBLI.

SJT filed an earnings release (8-K Item 2.02, Ex. 99.1) on September 18, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/319655/000119312526395495/sjt-ex99_1.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot? Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
